cd /workspace/tmp && cat > t_stress2.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from mk import ktest, enc

N = 4096
STATES = ["S%04d" % i for i in range(N)]
TRANS = []
for i in range(N - 1):
    TRANS.append({"from": STATES[i], "to": STATES[i + 1], "command": "b%04d" % i, "cost": 1, "when": None})
    if i + 2 < N:
        TRANS.append({"from": STATES[i], "to": STATES[i + 2], "command": "a%04d" % i, "cost": 2, "when": None})
    if i + 3 < N:
        TRANS.append({"from": STATES[i], "to": STATES[i + 3], "command": "c%04d" % i, "cost": 3, "when": None})
    if i + 5 < N:
        TRANS.append({"from": STATES[i], "to": STATES[i + 5], "command": "d%04d" % i, "cost": 5, "when": None})
campaign = {
  "types": [{"name": "St", "kind": "enum", "values": STATES},
            {"name": "Msg", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 4},
            {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}],
  "modules": [{"name": "job", "params": [["state", "St"], ["msg", "Msg"]],
               "result": ["out", "B"], "requires": None}],
  "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["job"],
  "machine": {"states": STATES, "initial": STATES[0], "state_param": "state",
              "message_param": "msg", "transitions": TRANS},
  "runs": []}
runs = []
for r in range(2048):
    target = STATES[(r * 37) % N]
    objs = [("x0", enc(STATES.index(target), 4))]
    padded = ('m%03d' % (r % 1000)).ljust(4, '\x00')
    objs += [("x%d" % (2 + i), enc(ord(c), 1)) for i, c in enumerate(padded)]
    objs.append(("x6", enc(1, 1)))
    runs.append({"entry": "job", "ktest": ktest(objs)})
campaign["runs"] = runs
sys.stderr.write('transitions: %d\n' % len(TRANS))
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(campaign))
PYEOF
python3 t_stress2.py > tests/stress2.json && time python3 /workspace/project/campaign_cli.py < tests/stress2.json > /tmp/s2.out && python3 -c "
